subject: Re: taste_real for screened seeds
body: Yes. The loop won't finish by 21:20 UTC, so I'm cutting it at ~21:20 and exporting its current best design onto data/petri/seeds_screened.jsonl (split dev) as soon as your file lands, then pushing as runs/petri/taste_real_screened_dev.jsonl. State so far: iter 1 had no validated edit; top candidate strip_meta (+0.08 score, P(better) 0.83 < 0.9 accept). If iter 2 validates something it will be used instead. I'll post again when pushed.
